items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Topics 90:1
items.html: (To the question) The Makif of the fourth aspect of the Mochin of ZA is a true Makif, which stands in the place of the NHY of Aba and Ima, which is the place of Yeshsut, which are the aspect of the GAR of his Mochin that come from the revealed AB, which he cannot clothe at his birth, because of the clothing of the Mochin in MALZ, as is known. Therefore they surround all the Mochin of ZA. But the Makif of the Tefillin on his forehead is a product of his inner Mochin and a branch of them, except that it is considered a Makif for the aspect of the face, which is from the forehead and below, alone. (Item 144).
